postings.title: Accounts Payable Specialist
postings.description:
About the role:

Forter is looking for a detail-oriented, responsible, and highly motivated Accounts Payable Specialist to join our Finance team. In this role, you will handle a range of accounts payable processes, including matching invoices against approved purchase orders, recording invoices, tracking expenses, performing bank and credit card reconciliations, and processing expense reimbursements.

What you’ll be doing:

- Oversee daily accounts payable activities, including those noted below, for Forter Ltd. and its subsidiaries

- Receive AP invoices and process them into Zip and NetSuite

- Reconcile the accounts payable ledger to ensure all bills and payments are accounted for and properly posted

- Perform bank reconciliations

- Collaborate with the Accounting team on daily tasks and the monthly close process, including fixed assets and prepaid expenses

- Monitor corporate payment tools (Zip CC, Mesh, credit cards), review and process employee travel and expense reimbursement reports, ensuring accuracy, policy compliance, and timely processing

- Verify and investigate vendor discrepancies, if any, by reconciling vendor accounts and monthly vendor statements

- Manage the AP aging and Employees aging reports on a monthly basis

- Manage Fixed assets module including purchases and disposals.

- Handling Israeli VAT reporting and performing periodic VAT reconciliations

- Support audit requests as needed

- Support ad hoc accounting projects as needed

What you’ll need:

Required:

- Certified Bookkeeper (Type 2 or higher)

- 4-8 years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including experience in the high-tech industry

- Strong verbal and written English skills

- Strong Excel skills (including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and data analysis)

- Strong organizational and time-management skills

- Strong analytical skills

- Ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

- Be able to Work Independently and as Part of the Team

* Preferred: Experience working with NetSuite, Mesh, Expensify, P2P - Zip

postings.title: Decision Analyst
postings.description:
About the role:

As a Decision Analyst at Forter, you will own one of the company’s most critical assets: the accuracy, robustness, and performance of what is widely recognized as the leading e-commerce fraud decisioning system in the industry.

You will be expected to think creatively and push boundaries, constantly improving how we identify fraud and protect legitimate customers. You will design logical and technical solutions to real, constantly evolving challenges faced by some of the world’s largest online retailers. Your work will operate at the intersection of deep data research, real-time production decisioning systems, and real-world impact.

This position has strong technical and analytical depth, but you don’t need prior coding experience. With agentic tools like Claude Code and our structured training, candidates that are a strong fit can close any technical gaps quickly. We hire across multiple levels and adjust the scope and level of ownership based on what we learn during the interview process.

You will join Forter’s Decision Science and Analytics department, a high-bar, fast-moving group with a strong culture of excellence, curiosity, and ownership. We work in an informal, collaborative environment where strong opinions are welcome and great ideas move fast. The role offers meaningful growth opportunities, with clear paths toward both senior individual contributor and managerial roles, allowing you to shape your career based on your strengths.

Your work will directly shape Forter’s product, protect hundreds of millions of consumers, and help define the future of trust in digital commerce.

What you'll be doing:

- Invent, design, implement, and continuously refine the core decisioning logic and models that run in Forter’s live production systems

- Research complex fraud patterns, adversarial behaviors, and emerging threats

- Leverage rich and diverse datasets to generate actionable insights, build new system components, and advance feature engineering efforts

- Use agentic tools such as Claude Code to develop automatic tools and processes that improve the accuracy, scalability, and efficiency of our systems

- Collaborate closely with Engineers, Product Managers, and business stakeholders to build the next generation of Forter’s AI-driven technology

What you'll need:

- Psychometric score above 700 or equivalent (e.g. GMAT) - we use this as a baseline measure of structured reasoning and analytical speed

- A record of high achievement, in whatever form that's taken in your life - academic, professional, military, or otherwise

- Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, with a proven ability to break down and solve highly complex problems

- Strong technical orientation. Experience with Python, SQL, or R is an advantage but not required. You should be comfortable learning new tools and technologies

- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical ideas and research outcomes to a wide range of audiences

- Natural curiosity and the ability to understand systemic behaviors and adversarial tactics

- Proactive and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently within a collaborative team

- Experience building things with AI: agentic workflows, apps, automations. Bring an example you built and can walk us through. You should be enthusiastic about and comfortable with agentic tools.

Bonus points for:

- Experience with SQL or Python

- Familiarity with machine learning concepts

- Background in risk analysis, intelligence, or adversarial research

postings.title: Enterprise Account Executive, West
postings.description:
About the role:

The Enterprise Account Executive will be responsible for driving new customer acquisition and establishing and nurturing a strong pipeline of some of the largest accounts in the market. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you must be highly driven, while also showing integrity and high emotional intelligence. We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional executive presence. You have to be able to manage a broad US West territory and be able to skillfully run the entire sales process, backed by a team of fraud experts.

What you'll be doing:

- Work closely with a large list of named prospect accounts across the US West region, utilizing a consultative approach to identify pain points and challenges that Forter's platform can help solve

- Manage a sales pipeline and process from initial outreach to presentation, negotiation, and close, following a MEDDPICC sales framework

- Identify and build relationships with economic champions / buyers within major accounts and position Forter's value proposition to the appropriate lines of business and technical teams

- Collaborate with Sales Development and Marketing teams to drive leads and account activity, as well as with our Pre-sales Solutions Consultants to create customized sales presentations and tailored ROI models

- Provide field analysis and feedback internally to help shape sales collateral and longer term expansion planning

- Represent Forter at industry events and sales meetings with key eCommerce players

What you'll need:

- High integrity and passion for winning

- Minimum of 5 years as a top quota carrying direct sales executive, with a track record of outperforming targets and annual quotas

- Proven success in selling innovative solutions/services to merchants / large enterprises is a must; with a focus on FinTech and eCommerce solutions (analytics, platforms, financial and/or technology solutions) highly preferred

- A strong network with a proven track record of enterprise sales within top 500 eCommerce companies is a big plus

- Demonstrated success in target account selling in a multi-regional capacity

- The ability to build strong relationships, as demonstrated through prior experience prospecting and leveraging industry contacts to develop and close new businesses

- A strong understanding of the online payment industry, including credit card issuing/acquiring experience and familiarity with its ecosystem (partners, resellers, processors) is also a big plus

- Experience in a fast-paced organization, with the ability to work in a rapidly expanding and changing environment

- Exceptional professional presence, with outstanding presentation and communication skills

- Ability to travel as required

Forter was built to meet this moment — and stay ahead of it.

postings.title: Implementation Engineer
postings.description:
About the role:

We're looking for an Implementation Engineer to own the successful delivery of Forter integrations for newly signed and expanding customers. This is a project management-led role: you are the delivery owner for your portfolio, responsible for driving each integration from kickoff to go-live on time, with strong stakeholder alignment and a clear line of sight to business value for the customer.

You'll bring the organisational rigor and proactive ownership that turns a complex, multi-stakeholder go-live into a predictable, repeatable process.

What you'll be doing:

- Own the end-to-end delivery of integration projects for your portfolio, acting as project lead and primary point of contact from kickoff through go-live.

- Build, maintain, and drive project plans to completion, proactively identifying risks and blockers and course-correcting before they threaten timelines.

- Lead project governance with customer stakeholders, setting agendas, tracking action items, and managing relationships with senior stakeholders and business users to keep them engaged and aligned through completion.

- Coordinate cross-functionally with Sales, Solutions Consulting, Customer Success, and Analytics, including partnering with an Analytics Consultant to translate technical integration progress into insights that meet customers' fraud prevention needs, to remove obstacles and hit agreed go-live dates.

- Serve as a technical translator on your projects, clearly articulating integration concepts (API operations, JavaScript, JSON, and other web/database technologies) to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Track and report on project health and delivery metrics for your portfolio, flagging risks early in team meetings.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Forter's implementation playbooks and processes, feeding back learnings from your projects.

What you'll need: 

- 5+ years of experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects on behalf of Enterprise customers, including engaging senior customer stakeholders and holding cross-functional teams accountable; project/program management experience is the core requirement for this role.

- A proven track record running multiple concurrent projects, building structured project plans, and driving them to on-time completion.

- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with a consistent focus on delivery quality and customer experience.

- An owner's mindset: proactive, accountable, and comfortable driving a project forward without being told to.

- Working technical fluency with API integrations, JavaScript, JSON concepts, and other web/database technologies, enough to bridge technical and business conversations; hands-on build experience is not required.

- Experience working in a multinational environment.

- Previous experience in payments or ecommerce is a plus.

- Proficiency in data analysis tools (SQL, Python) and experience with customer segmentation or large dataset trend analysis is a plus.

postings.description:
About the role:

The Customer Success department is the backbone of Forter. As a Principal CSM, you are a key commercial lead responsible for the health, retention, and growth of our strategic accounts. We put a great deal of faith in our CSMs, who own not only customer satisfaction but also renewals, expansion, and strategic ROI. In this role, you’ll build lasting executive relationships and solve complex business challenges, developing the commercial and technical skills that will be the cornerstone of your future career.

- 7+ years of post-live, client-facing CS experience with a proven track record of managing renewals and hitting retention targets.

- Commercial Acumen: Experience leading executive-level business reviews focused on ROI, budgets, and long-term contract value.

- Strategic Planning: Ability to communicate client objectives to internal leadership to execute high-impact account strategies.

- Industry Context: Experience in a SaaS startup; background in payments, fraud, or fintech is a significant bonus.

postings.title: Recovery Analyst Student
postings.description:
About the role:

Forter is looking for a Recovery Analyst Student to join our team and help increase our merchants’ margins by fighting fraud chargebacks.

As a member of our growing Recoveries team, you will manually submit dispute cases to recover funds on behalf of our merchants. You’ll work hands-on across payment platform portals, track each case through to its outcome, and help us keep our success rates high. Most of our process is automated, and this role owns the part that still requires a person to handle manually.

We are looking for a results-driven person with strong attention to detail, a high sense of responsibility, and a strong teamwork mentality.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Manage end-to-end dispute workflows directly across multiple payment platform portals.

- Track, update, and maintain accurate dispute statuses to ensure seamless operational tracking.

- Monitor chargeback outcomes to identify recurring patterns and support team performance improvements.

- Contribute ideas to improve our performance and streamline and automate our processes, using AI tools.

Who You Are

- A Bachelor’s student with at least 3 semesters left.

- Highly organized and responsible, with strong attention to detail and the discipline to stay accurate on high-volume work.

- Able to follow structured processes and instructions, and to work independently when needed.

- A strong communicator with fluent English.

- Highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets.

- Available for a 50% position (2.5 days a week), with at least 2 days a week working from our Tel Aviv offices.

postings.description:
About the role:

Forter's Chargeback Recovery (CBR) and Dispute Management products help the world's largest merchants autonomously win back revenue lost to chargebacks. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager based in Tel Aviv to own this domain end-to-end, reporting to our Product Director, Risk Platform.

This is a unique opportunity to own a product that sits at the intersection of payments, integrations and AI transformation. You'll own the strategy and roadmap for how Forter ingests disputes from payment service providers (PSPs), builds and submits evidence, and recovers revenue for merchants. That includes our transition toward in-house dispute capabilities and a growing ecosystem of PSP integrations. You’ll work alongside Engineering and Decision Science teams in building the product capabilities, and alongside Sales, Implementation, and Customer Success to bring it to market and make it land with enterprise merchants.

If you know how a chargeback moves from a cardholder's bank to a merchant's representment letter, you want to build the product that automates that entire lifecycle and you’re excited about taking your offerings to market, this role was built for you.

What you'll be doing:

- Roadmap & Strategy: Define the vision and long-term roadmap for Chargeback Recovery and Dispute Management. You'll make the hard calls on build vs. partner, automation vs. manual operations, and where to invest in improving the customer experience. 

- Platform Ownership: Own the full product surface: the merchant-facing UI and experience, dispute ingestion (webhooks, APIs, batch/SFTP), dispute submission, and core capabilities like our evidence recommendation engine, automation rules, evidence API and letter generation.

- PSP Ecosystem & Orchestration: Set the strategy for how Forter connects to direct PSPs and processors to ingest and dispute chargebacks at scale. 

- AI transformation: Lead the evolution of our Dispute Agent and related AI capabilities. You'll identify where multi-step AI can replace manual work for merchants and our internal teams, and translate that into features with measurable efficiency gains.

- End to End Ownership and Leadership: Own releases end-to-end: requirements, internal training, rollout, adoption monitoring, and feedback. You'll run a regular Dispute Management Product Council with GTM stakeholders to keep the field informed and feed their input back into the roadmap.

You'll support complex enterprise deals from first call through go-live, help Implementation navigate tricky merchant integrations, and step in on escalations post-launch. You'll also work directly with strategic enterprise merchants through recurring product syncs.

- Product Ownership: 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a proven track record of owning a domain end-to-end: defining roadmaps, shipping complex capabilities, and driving commercial outcomes.
